answer: Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 45 aliases, and each one needs its own funded dune account. Deposits are visible in lagoon, and reef reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 42% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 355 aliases cost 249 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
